_note: Numbers that exist only in prose or in traces that aren't committed. Each block names its source. Everything else in data.js is read from committed JSON by build_data.py.

paysim._source: README.md, docs/media/fraud-rule-book.png. Simulated data and a different cost setup from IEEE-CIS.

phase14._source: fraud/RESULTS-IEEE-AMOUNT.md, Good customers declined. Logreg with two lines, then with the rule.

recipe._source: fraud/finetune_ieee.py docstring (--full: rows, batches); fraud/finetune_d1.py LORA and fraud/finetune.py (LR, WARMUP_STEPS, BATCH); fraud/d1torch.py (the model); fraud/eval_ieee.py boot_ci and boot_auc (resamples); fraud/RESULTS-TABULAR.md (trees); fraud/DATA-IEEE.md (fraud share of the fit rows).

bands._source: fraud/RESULTS-LM-COST.md, Frauds stopped by size. Counted from traces, not in the JSON.

stress._source: fraud/RESULTS-COST-STRESS.md, flat price per good customer declined: not distinguishable up to 30 USD; the mean flips between 50 and 60 USD

predictions._source: fraud/eval_lm_cost.py docstring (stated before running); fraud/RESULTS-LM-COST.md, Predictions against what happened

rows.said: Cost lower than lm-rich by about 100, not distinguishable
Frauds of 500 USD or more stopped rise
Frauds stopped overall fall a little
Beats logreg by about 100, not distinguishable

nilson._source: ../midterm-proposal/PLAN.md, References [1]: The Nilson Report, "Card fraud losses worldwide in 2023," no. 1276, Dec. 2024. Documented.

data._source: fraud/DATA.md (PaySim: 6,362,620 rows, 8,213 fraud, steps 1-743 = 31 days; one fraud in 775 is 6,362,620 / 8,213 rounded); fraud/eval_ieee.py WINDOW_SIZE (rows per window). Observed; the window size is an Implementation choice.

illustration._source: Implementation choice: made-up inputs to show the mechanism on the worked PaySim payment; no rule, logistic regression or tree scored this payment, and the slides label these numbers 'illustration'. Only the inputs are here (logistic-regression start and weights, the tree start, questions and leaves, lambda, the small payment's amount); slides/build_data.py illustration_block derives every other number from them, worked and costs.

paysim_ft._source: fraud/RESULTS-FT.md (eval 20261005-022333): 20 new test windows of 500 transactions each; hybrid-ft cheaper than logistic regression in 19 of 20; cost of training from the manifest: 12,084 examples, 52 min on the laptop's iGPU. PaySim's own prices: review 50 USD, friction at least 10 USD (the pinned trace's header). Observed.

tabular_dev._source: fraud/RESULTS-TABULAR.md, 'Held-out dev, 88 chains, no bar' (fraud/tabular.py heldout_dev): the dev read of trees against logistic regression. Lambda for trees was picked with these rows in, so that read is flattered (Observed).

customer_line._source: fraud/eval_final.py docstring (final-signal-cust: Phase 18's flat 10 USD in the expected cost of declining, never in what it's charged); fraud/eval_combos.py FLAT. Implementation choice.

conventions._source: fraud/eval_ieee.py boot_ci (a percentile 95% interval of the mean, windows resampled); fraud/eval_final.py docstring (the latency bar is on p90: 90% of lone prompts at or under 250 ms). Implementation choice.

training_loss._source: fraud/finetune_d1.py docstring (IEEE-CIS and d1 training: cross-entropy over the three option scores divided by calibration.json's temperature, 3.383); fraud/finetune.py docstring and train loop (PaySim Qwen training: cross-entropy over the whole vocabulary at the answer position). Implementation choice.
